answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 10 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. The vine multiplier is published, charged in marble, and summit lists each payment. A burst of registrations thus prices itself out, because the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. A farm of 4333 identities would post 4783 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
